_archive: V2 state archived to .harness/state-v2-archive.json. V2 final: D1=0.72 D3=0.31 (n=50), JIRA injection brought D3=0.35 on n=20.
vision: Build a bug attribution agent: given a JIRA bug report (title + description), autonomously search a git repository to identify the commit that introduced the bug. The agent uses git tools (log, blame, diff, show) with temporal bounds, producing a ranked list of suspect commits with evidence-grounded causal explanations. Evaluated via Hit@k, MRR, and attribution quality metrics against ApacheJIT ground truth.
direction: V3 implementation complete. Data infrastructure ready (10 repos, JIRA cache, 20/20 cases runnable). Docs fully aligned: 7-stage agentic loop spec in system-specification.md, stage-to-metric mapping in evaluation-framework.md, all cross-references updated (agent-loop.md, glossary.md, architecture.md, etc.). Next: first-live-eval (P2) — run baselines + agent against real data, establish Hit@5 floor. We have zero real numbers.

invariants.temporal_bound: Agent sees repo up to COMMIT_B~1 (parent of earliest fix commit). COMMIT_B diff/content/message are NOT visible. JIRA ticket (title + description) is the input -- temporally valid (created before fix).
invariants.llm_reasons_scripts_verify: LLM owns search strategy, candidate selection, and attribution reasoning. Scripts own evidence grounding (verifying quotes against diffs) and report assembly.
invariants.ground_truth: GroundTruthGraph provides bug_hash from commit_links.csv. SZZ-based labeling has known noise -- Hit@5 is primary metric, not Hit@1.

acceptance_thresholds.note: Thresholds are provisional -- will be calibrated after first eval run and baseline comparison.

v2_final.note: V2 final scores (different problem, not directly comparable). Archived for reference.
